rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for marking a contrast or concession.

example.english: It’s raining today, but I nonetheless have to go out.
example.traditional: 今日落雨，不過我都要出去。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 bat1 gwo3 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 ceot1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when the point is that a state or quality continues despite the preceding fact.

example.english: Although I’m so tired, I nonetheless finish the report.
example.traditional: 雖然咁攰，我仍然做埋份報告。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 gam3 gui6 ngo5 jing4 jin4 zou6 maai4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when an action or outcome goes ahead just the same despite the circumstances.

example.english: No one came with me, but I nonetheless went travelling on my own.
example.traditional: 冇人陪我去，我照樣自己去旅行。
example.jyutping: mou5 jan4 pui4 ngo5 heoi3 ngo5 ziu3 joeng6 zi6 gei2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
